transcript: So I chose the modern green utopia as the most preferred just because like sustainability and security I think were driving factors of keeping the utopia functioning and without that sustainability piece there might not be a world in which people can live. Then the primitive utopia, this one seemed fine. It's just my personal preference is not to live in a primitive society. And then finally, I chose my least preferred to be the AI-centered utopia as I think that this opens itself up to an incredible amount of bias depending on who the AI has been built by, what decisions the AI makes.
